title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, OPRO Co., Ltd.'s board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 40,000 shares of common stock, representing 1.7% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum consideration of ¥87 million. The shares will be purchased through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 14, 2026 through January 29, 2027.

The company identified two primary purposes for this acquisition. First, it intends to use acquired shares to support stock-based compensation programs and to enable flexible execution of capital management strategies. Second, the board determined that the company's current stock price does not adequately reflect its business performance, future growth potential, and financial position. Accordingly, the acquisition is designed to improve capital efficiency under this assessment of undervaluation.
